series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Inside the barricaded high school faculty lounge, Takashi, Rei, Saya, and the surviving students watch live television in stunned horror. Special news bulletins report that riot police in major metropolitan areas are being overwhelmed by assailants who are already biologically deceased. The broadcast escalates into global catastrophe: the American president flees the White House to an airborne command aircraft, contact with Moscow is completely lost, Beijing burns, and nuclear retaliation protocols are considered. Realizing that civilization has collapsed worldwide, the survivors realize no outside rescue is coming.
Prior events (Part 2): With outside help an impossibility, genius student Saya Takagi breaks down the terrifying science of the outbreak. Comparing it to the historical Black Death and Spanish Flu, she points out a grim deviation: unlike regular disease victims, these corpses reanimate and relentlessly hunt the living. Dismissing hopes that summer heat will decompose the bodies, Saya warns they will walk indefinitely. Takashi convinces the group to unite and escape toward the parking lot to find their families. Inspecting the hallway, Saya deduces a critical secret: the monsters cannot see and react purely to sound.
Prior events (Part 3): Takashi steps forward to test Saya's auditory hypothesis, with kendo champion Saeko Busujima volunteering to stand at his side as vanguard. Creating a noise diversion down the hall, the group watches as the zombies shamble toward the sound, completely ignoring the quiet teenagers right beside them. With the theory proven, the group mounts a coordinated breakout. Takashi bludgeons through the corridor, Saeko slices with lethal sword strikes, and Kohta provides suppressing fire with his modified nail gun. Reaching the parking area, Nurse Shizuka starts the minibus engine just as screams ring out.
Prior events (Part 4): The desperate screams belong to a second group of surviving students, led by teacher Koichi Shido. As they frantically dash across the zombie-swarmed courtyard toward the waiting bus, an injured student stumbles and falls, pleading desperately for his teacher's hand. Instead of helping, Shido flashes a chilling smile and kicks the helpless boy straight into the ravenous undead, declaring coldly that the weak do not deserve survival. While the horde devours the abandoned teenager, Shido scrambles safely aboard the minibus, immediately asserting his authority over Takashi's stunned group.
Prior events (Part 5): Inside the speeding minibus, the traumatized students weep as the school vanishes in the distance. Capitalizing on their sheer terror, teacher Shido begins a cunning psychological campaign, preaching that obedience and absolute hierarchy are their only hope. Panicked students quickly fall under his spell, accepting him as their undisputed leader. But Rei Miyamoto refuses to bow down: she reveals that Shido corruptly sabotaged her academic career to spite her detective father. When Shido threatens to exile anyone who questions him, Rei demands to leave the bus, and Takashi refuses to let her go alone.
